A '''shop''' was operated by the [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]] group [[TechTank]] on the lower levels of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], concealed inside the holding tank of a large [[Water/Legends|water]] processing center. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sinasu]] became engaged in a gang war with his rival [[Noako]] and he went into hiding in TechTank. However, a [[Pon|member of Sinasu's organization]] betrayed his location and the shop fell under attack from [[Cordol's Chain]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] group that was working for Noako.
